story.title: Our Journey
paragraphs: From humble beginnings as a small startup nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, Vama Prints and Technologies Private Limited has embarked on a remarkable journey that has propelled them onto the global stage.

Since our inception in 2005, we've been a name synonymous with excellence in Label Printing and ink. In the year 2020, we took a momentous step forward, expanding our horizons to embrace product manufacturing, and thus, Ultranex Transfer Release Film was born.

timeline.label: Company Founded
timeline.desc: Vama Prints & Technologies established in Mumbai, India

timeline.desc: Expanded into product manufacturing with Ultranex DTF Film

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.body: Our commitment to quality is unwavering. We have invested in cutting-edge technology, stringent quality control measures, and a dedicated team of experts to ensure that every Ultranex product you receive meets the highest industry standards. When you choose Ultranex, you're choosing a product that's not just reliable but also a testament to the perfection that is achievable through the convergence of technology and dedication.
